atthakusala.cp: adj. clever in finding what is beneficial; clever in exposition.
atthakusala.p: [Attha+kusala] (ti) Google Translate (1) In the sense of "skilled"; In the eighth stanza, skillful, skillful, He is (2) skillful in deeds. Clever in his own interests; he.

C: atthakusala：[adj．] clever in finding what is beneficial; clever in exposition．
K:
atthakusala：အတ္ထကုသလ （တိ）
[အတ္ထ+ကုသလ]
（၁） အနက်အဓိပ္ပါယ်၌-ကျွမ်းကျင်-လိမ္မာ-သော၊ အဋ္ဌကထာ၌-ကျွမ်းကျင်-လိမ္မာ-သော၊ သူ။ （၂） အကျင့်၌ လိမ္မာသော၊ မိမိအကျိုးစီးပွါး၌ လိမ္မာသော၊ သူ။
R:
atthakusala：အတ္ထ-ကုသလ （တိ）
အကျိုးစီးပွား၌ လိမ္မာသည်။ အဋ္ဌကထာ၌ လိမ္မာသည်။
CPD: attha-kusala , mfn. 1. skilful as to what is good ( esp. one's own spiritual welfare ); Sn 143 (karaṇīyaṃ ~ena; Pj); Ja l 366, 3-5 . — 2. conversant with the 'meaning' ( regarding the explanation of the holy scrip- tures ); + dhamma-kusalo, vyañjana-k°, nirutti-k°, pubbâpara-k°, AN lll 201, 23 ( quoted Psl 4, 11 ; = attha-kusala lfc. v. an-°.
